evidence_quotes.quote: Cost determination and sustainable financing for rural water

publication_year_note: Mismatched PDF: the retrieved file is Peter A. Harvey (Water Policy 9 (2007) 373-391; received 19 December 2005, accepted 29 March 2006, © IWA Publishing 2007, doi: 10.2166/wp.2007.012) rather than target study S190 (Kumasi T.C., 'Financing sustainable water service delivery of small town water systems in ghana: The gaps and needs', DOI 10.13044/j.sdewes.d6.0195). Per audit rule 2, verified_publication_year is set to cannot_tell.
rationale: The retrieved Drive PDF does not match Study S190. Study S190 is cited as Kumasi T.C., 'Financing sustainable water service delivery of small town water systems in ghana: The gaps and needs' (DOI: 10.13044/j.sdewes.d6.0195), whereas the provided 20-page PDF is Peter A. Harvey (2007), 'Cost determination and sustainable financing for rural water services in sub-Saharan Africa', published in Water Policy 9 (2007) 373-391 (DOI: 10.2166/wp.2007.012). Following strict audit rule 2 for a mismatched paper, quant_verdict and verified_publication_year are set to 'cannot_tell' and paper_read to 'not accessible'. (Incidentally, the mismatched Harvey 2007 paper itself contains only illustrative worked handpump cost-accounting and annuity tariff calculations with zero inferential statistics.)
